newsitem.title: FRANCE: Franc stabilises vs mark, losses seen limited.
newsitem.headline: Franc stabilises vs mark, losses seen limited.

text.p: The French franc extended overnight losses against the mark on the back of a surprise win for the opposition left in the first round of a parliamentary election but quickly stabilised and traders said they did not expect a blow out on Monday.

The franc fell as low as 3.3755 per mark overnight from 3.3714 before the first election results were released and then slipped to 3.3773 in the early exchanges on Monday. It was trading at 3.3753 at 0814 GMT.
A foreign exchange trader at a French bank in Paris said he did not expect the franc to fall below 3.3775 per mark today.
